text: Operational intervention during web-review iteration 0: after the browser step produced no new evidence and two status requests went unanswered, the coordinator interrupted and resumed the same reviewer. The worker reported that socket creation was denied before ChromeDriver started and its required sandbox escalation remained pending for 410.9 seconds until the interruption aborted it; no rejection reason or browser result was returned. Completed fidelity work was preserved. The reviewer was instructed to finish independent offline comparisons before any renewed browser escalation, respect approval requirements, bound waits, and report actual performed checks. No artifact, finding, review criterion or verdict was changed.
